blaKPC-2.name: blaKPC-2 (Serine Carbapenemase)
blaKPC-2.mechanism: Class A serine carbapenemase hydrolyzes carbapenems, cephalosporins, and penicillins.

blaCTX-M-15.name: blaCTX-M-15 (Extended-Spectrum Beta-Lactamase)
blaCTX-M-15.mechanism: Class A ESBL hydrolyzes 3rd/4th generation oxyimino-cephalosporins and penicillins.

aac(6')-Ib.name: aac(6')-Ib (Aminoglycoside Acetyltransferase)
aac(6')-Ib.mechanism: Covalently acetylates the 6' position of aminoglycosides, disrupting ribosomal A-site binding.

gyrA_S83L.name: gyrA (S83L QRDR Mutation)
gyrA_S83L.mechanism: Point mutation in DNA Gyrase subunit A (Ser83Leu) disrupting fluoroquinolone binding.

dfrA14.name: dfrA14 (Dihydrofolate Reductase)
dfrA14.mechanism: Expresses drug-resistant dihydrofolate reductase, conferring high-level trimethoprim resistance.

fosA.name: fosA (Glutathione S-Transferase)
fosA.mechanism: Glutathione S-transferase catalyzes addition of glutathione to fosfomycin, inactivating it.

blaNDM-1.name: blaNDM-1 (Metallo-beta-lactamase 1)
blaNDM-1.mechanism: Zinc-dependent Class B MBL hydrolyzes carbapenems, cephalosporins, and penicillins.

armA.name: armA (16S rRNA Methyltransferase)
armA.mechanism: m7G1405 methylation of 16S rRNA in 30S ribosome, conferring pan-aminoglycoside resistance.

mcr-1.name: mcr-1 (Phosphoethanolamine Transferase)
mcr-1.mechanism: Adds phosphoethanolamine to Lipid A, neutralizing LPS negative charge to block polymyxins.
